summary: This week in AI news, significant advancements were made in robotics, LLMs, and AI security. Google revealed Gemini Robotics 2.0, promising improved dexterity and safety, while Meta announced plans to make AI more accessible to individuals. Meanwhile, Okta acquired AI security startup Permiso, highlighting the growing importance of AI security.
insight: The increasing use of AI in various industries has led to a surge in demand for AI security solutions, with companies like Okta and Microsoft investing heavily in this area.
highlights: Google's Gemini Robotics 2.0 promises improved dexterity and safety
Meta plans to make AI more accessible to individuals, with a focus on personal AI agents
Okta acquires AI security startup Permiso, highlighting the growing importance of AI security
